page.overview:
Who is Amethio?

Amethio is a recurring character appearing in , who was a higher-up of the Explorers.

Amethio is a young boy with purple eyes. Along with his black and silver hair color, he wears black pants with a purple stripe on his right side. He also wears a dark purple sweatshirt with a purple stripe going down his left side, black gloves, and dark purple shoes. His attire is donned with a polo tie with a dark purple triangular gem.

As a child, Amethio wore a white long-sleeved shirt, grey suspenders, as well as black socks and shoes.

As a preteen, Amethio wore a white shirt, a grey sleeveless sweatervest, black trousers and shoes. He also started wearing his bolo tie during that age.
